name: @owncontext/desktop
description: Unsigned local-first OwnContext developer preview for non-sensitive evaluation data.
author: OwnContext project contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:forge: npm run build --workspace @owncontext/core && npm run build --workspace @owncontext/mcp-server && npm run build && node scripts/build-forge-runtime.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
